name: Emerge Aquaponics

evidence.quote_or_summary: Site navigation lists Buy and Wholesale only; subscription for lettuce at buy page

notes: No CSA on the farm's site. It does offer a lettuce subscription (weekly, bi-weekly or monthly, 20% off: 1.5 lb $14, 3 lb $22) for pickup at the farm stand, 4135 Shoup Rd, Fri 1pm-Mon 7pm; orders by noon Thursday. Farm stand open 8am-7pm daily; Backyard Market in Black Forest, 6845 Shoup Rd, Sat 9am-1pm (May-Oct). Could be treated as a produce subscription rather than a CSA.
